sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 160. Success value 100. 5x physical damage (Star).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 160. Success value 100. 5x magic damage (Star).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all allies. Permits piercing through damage reduction/reflection effects when attacking for 90 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Applies Diffusion. The next Ability used will change from a specified single/range target to targeting all (except for certain Abilities).
-Target: all allies. Applies Awakening. (Activates for 60 seconds when HP reaches 60% or below.)
-Target: all allies. Deals 40% of current HP as damage. [Demerit]
-Target: all allies. Recovers 100 Cost.
-Target: yourself. Applies Protection for 120 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; increases DEF and MDEF by 100%; nullifies status ailments, debuffs, and buff removal effects. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).

-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 260. Success value 100. 5x magic damage (Star).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Removes 40 Cost.
-Target: all enemies. Reduces Unison gauge by 30.
-Target: all enemies. Reduces healing received by 100% for 60 seconds.
-Target: all enemies. Applies Constriction. The next Ability used will change from targeting all to a single target (except for certain Abilities).
-Target: all enemies. Applies despair for 60 seconds with a success value of 110.
-Target: all enemies. Applies a jealousy state that nullifies Unison gauge fill 1 time.
-Target: all enemies. Fills Unison gauge by 20. [Demerit]
-Target: yourself. Applies Rampart for 120 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; [Special] increases all elemental Unison damage Ability Power by 200; [Special] increases success value of all status ailment attacks, including Unison Effects and Ability Effects, by 50; nullifies special debuffs; nullifies debuffs; nullifies Unison gauge reduction. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 20000
Increases your star elemental Unison damage Ability Power by 30.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 20000

[Ice Wolf Symbiotic Pair] Natrya & Vega or Ninoyu with the same or higher Cost of the base Monster can be used as fodder.
 *Specific Monsters may also be used. See the Help section for details.
